notes.title: Profiles Update: Link Crosshairs and Keybinds to Games Easily!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re back with a highly anticipated update that finally brings Profiles to Crosshair X. 

📁 What is a Profile?
A Profile is a bundle of settings you save for a game or app. It includes:

 Default crosshair (used when the profile loads)
 Keybinds
 Position and size settings

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/f8ac0fa97b0adb26ffda808d4242349515cdd2d5.png

Important: To change your profile settings, just set it as active and make any changes within Crosshair X — they’ll be saved automatically!



✨ New Profiles Page
What's New:

 Create new profiles for each game or app
 Attach profiles to apps for automatic switching
 Manage all your saved profiles in one place

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/53aded746f0157d966c5a2bb4294dbfe19e1e258.png




🎯 App-Specific Crosshairs
You can now set your crosshair to only appear in the app you choose! Attach a profile to an application, and Crosshair X will automatically show or hide the crosshair based on which app you’re using.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/f6dd899b30f5be3b9a3ec773e19a45169165ad79.gif
(Keep an eye out for the green controller indicator)




🔍 Profile Detection
Profile Detection automatically switches to the right profile when you use a linked app. If you’ve set up a profile for that app, Crosshair X will load it automatically!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/6c505055107168678483cd2d6fc520e1f2325b56.gif



🛠️ Additional Changes
What's new:

 Added an indicator for the current profile in the top bar.
 Added Profile selector to the "Keybinds" page.
 Added Profile selector to the "Positon & Size" page.
 Added global setting for "Profile Detection".




 👋 That's everything 

Thanks for all your support — Hope you enjoy the new update and we’re excited to celebrate our 5-year anniversary with you in June!  

— Crosshair X Team 🦆

notes.title: Designer Upgrade: More Animation Settings, and More Control
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're beginning to focus on improving our designer and give you all the best set of tools out there —this one’s all about unlocking your creativity and giving you more control than ever before.

🔤 Rename Your Layers

 You can now rename a layer by clicking the name of the layer you have selected.
 To remove a name, simply delete the text and click outside the input box.
 Layers now highlight on hover without needing to select, making it easier to know what you're about to click.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/97eed1af17163363835077e5ebd661ecb4db181f.gif


🎬 Animate Everything

Full Animation Control: You can now animate every setting in Line, Center Dot, Outline, and Layer Settings.
Find Everything in One Place: All new animation options are available in the Animations tab in the Designer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/86e818fefd9deb7abc7ac02e9f1e0d21a367dbda.gif
Simplified Effects:

 "Inwards" and "Outwards" modifiers replaced by Line "Gap" animation setting.
   "Bloom" moved to Line "Gap" animation setting.
   "Opacity" now controlled per Line, Outline, and Center Dot animation settings.
   "T-Shape" effect has been migrated to the new Line "Visible" animation setting.
   The Line "Visible" animation setting lets you choose which lines appear or disappear at the end of the animation (defaults to the current Visible value set in the Line settings tab).


⏱️New Easing Options

Ease In 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/52065f3b3f7f6081e71dba91bd0b476abab43b8a.gif

Ease Out
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/4d7491fbe8ab1b6d403175af59fef4435c4e24f3.gif

Bounce
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/cb78d55c4b58393861dbf496ccbde4ad7e6d2696.gif

Elastic Easing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/7fe83ea4cee57b308f9360e53db2646c1c38f1ab.gif



⚙️Other Improvements and Fixes

 Fixed an issue where animations would not load when setting a saved crosshair to appear on aim.
 Fixed small styling issues: content no longer shifts when switching between tabs with or without a scrollbar.



🚀 Time to Cook 

That’s it for this update!

We're working on adding more animation controls, crosshair shapes, and making the Designer even more powerful.

Got ideas for new features or center dot options? Let us know in either the comments or our Discord Community  — we’re always looking for ways to help you create even better designs.

Thanks for the support — see you next time!

-- The Crosshair X team 🦆

notes.title: Holiday Theme, Improvements and More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! The holidays are here, and we couldn’t be more excited to share our festive update with you! This release is packed with some shiny new features, including a revamped Display Modes page, enhanced Streamer Settings, and more surprises to unwrap.

As the year comes to a close, we want to take a moment to thank you all for an incredible 2024. Your feedback has driven some of our biggest improvements—like the Keybinds system and the Designer upgrades—and we’re already looking ahead to 2025 with even bigger plans.

During the holiday season, we’d love to hear from you! Share your ideas and suggestions, and help us make the app even better in the new year.

Now, let’s dive into the details of this festive update!


🎄Holiday Theme
To get you into the holiday spirit, we’ve given the app a festive makeover! You’ll notice rope lights, candy cane-inspired accents, and a sprinkle of snow to set the perfect winter vibe. We hope this update adds a little extra cheer to your season!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/4e28f774b9aef2035455df5835f053d8d7e182f2.png
And don’t worry—if festive isn’t your thing, you can easily toggle the holiday theme on or off from the Options page.


In addition to this, we’ve added a "Happy Holidays" tab to the sidebar -- You can check out the winners of our Festive Crosshair Contest that was hosted on our Discord. The creativity from our community blew us away, and we’re excited to showcase their holiday-themed designs!

If you don’t want to miss out on future giveaways, contests, and more, be sure to Join our Discord! It’s the best place to stay in the loop, share your ideas, and connect with other crosshair enthusiasts.


✨ More Featured Crosshairs! 
We’ve also expanded our crosshair collection with even more options for newly featured games like CS2 and Valorant. Thanks to your feedback, we’ve added a variety of new styles to help you find the perfect fit.

And for our CS2 players, we’re excited to introduce spray pattern crosshairs—a game-changer for mastering your recoil control! Be sure to check them out and let us know what you think.


🎮 Game Bar Health Check Revamp
We’ve given the Game Bar page a major overhaul to make setup smoother and faster than ever. You’ll now see the setup status directly on the main page, so you can easily check that everything’s ready to go for Game Bar mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/bc6758ce78e4f4f4f3a831bd8712cfdbd15941a3.png

But that’s not all—we’ve also added the ability to launch Crosshair X + Game Bar with a single button click. This is a HUGE quality-of-life improvement for those who already have everything set up, letting you jump straight into the action with no extra steps.


🎥 Calling all Streamers!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/45743cbe986fc329de6f1a7e00bfb47b393910b7.gif

We’ve revamped the Recording/Streaming Options page to provide more helpful tools and guidance for setting up your stream or recording with Crosshair X. Plus, we’ve added downloadable assets to enhance your stream and show off your support. Join our growing content creator community and help us expand our reach!

In addition, for those who use our Streamer Server feature. There is now a guided health check to help you get setup!


Thanks for reading, and we hope you enjoy the Festive Update! As always, we’d love to hear your feedback—join the conversation, share your holiday-themed crosshairs, and let us know what you think.

Wishing you a joyful holiday season,
The Crosshair X Team 🎄🎁

(Comment “It’s time to deck the balls” if you made it this far!)

notes.title: New Designer, Search Page and More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’re thrilled to share our latest major update with you—the Designer 2 and Search Update. This one’s big, with a totally overhauled Designer packed full of new tools and features to give you even more control over your crosshairs. Plus, we’ve made finding community-made crosshairs easier than ever with a brand-new Search tab. There’s a lot to cover, so let’s jump right in!

🔍 Search 
In case you missed it in our last update, we added a Search feature to the Crosshairs page! Now, you can browse the workshop, check out the most popular crosshairs, and try them out—all without leaving the page. We hope this makes it easier and more fun to explore the amazing creations shared by our community.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/42b1d6395b836b93fc0376f8ef20efd5a062228e.png


🎨 New Designer 2
Meet the new Designer—redesigned for better performance, intuitive controls, and more customization options. Continue reading for extensive list of whats new:

Layout 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/be611ecf78949fdae57174389481b5587bc2b424.png

Improved Performance: Sliders now respond instantly, and lag issues have been eliminated.
Resizable Zones: Adjust the size of the preview and layer manager sections to create a layout that works best for you.
Tabbed Settings: Design settings are now grouped into easy-to-navigate tabs, making it faster to find and adjust settings like layers, animations, and visual properties.
Tab Component Preview: Quickly see a visual representation of each layer component—lines, outlines, dots, animations, and more—directly within the settings tabs.


Live Preview
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/5640abfca34f655433bce03108a788497f41c544.gif

Layer Highlighting: Easily identify the active layer you're working on with visual highlights.
 Animation Preview: See how your crosshair animations look inside the designer. To activate just click and hold your Aim / Fire key while in the designer.
 Zoom / Pan Controls: Easily adjust your view inside the designer by scrolling with your mouse mouse wheel to zoom or drag with left click to pan.


 Features 

Undo / Redo  - Easily step back or forward through your design changes with a full edit history.
Multi-Layer Selection - Quickly Select all, specific, or a range of layers
Multi-Layer Edits -  Apply color changes or adjust settings across multiple selected layers in one go
Import Crosshairs: You can now combine designs effortlessly by importing another crosshair into your current project to create unique, customized masterpieces.
Color Removal: Remove color from the center dot, outline, or lines to create unique effects, like fade-in animations or outline-only crosshairs.
Save & Replace: Easily replace existing crosshairs when saving to keep your library clean and organized.



 Shortcuts 
 Undo: CTRL + Z
 Redo: CTRL + SHIFT + Z
 Select All Layers: CTRL + A
 Append Select / Unselect Specific Layer: CTRL + Click
 Range Layer Select: SHIFT + Click


Thanks for reading, and we hope you enjoy the Designer 2 and Search Update! As always, we’d love to hear your thoughts—join the conversation and share your creations with the community.  

Happy designing,  
The Crosshair X Team

(Comment "it's time to bring back the crack" if you made it this far)

notes.title: New Keybinds Page, Controller Support and More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We're excited to bring you another major update that we think you'll love. There's a lot to unpack in this announcement as we've introduced even more customization options to help you get the most out of Crosshair X.

One of the highlights of this update is a brand-new page where you can set your keybinds and tailor your Crosshair X experience to match your play style. We've also enhanced support for setting keybinds with controllers, along with several other UX improvements.

Keybinds Page
Introducing the new Keybinds experience! With a familiar and intuitive UI, you can now easily set custom crosshair keybinds and update your aim and fire keys.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/466fcc5f52cfba2d83db1620e5ddb130d9b80426.png

Here you can set keybinds for:

 Global Toggle: Set a keybind to toggle the visibility of your crosshair on or off. Whether you’re using a keyboard, or controller, you can customize this to your preference.
 Aim: Assign a keybind for aiming, choosing from various inputs to ensure it feels natural whether you’re using a mouse or controller. Additionally, you can assign actions to be triggered when the aim key is pressed. More details on this below.
 Fire: Set a keybind for firing. Again, this is customizable across different input devices, giving you full control over your gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/5f68b31c25d8c39a96e3385bf1034b377c4b0b06.png

 Crosshairs: Assign keybinds to a saved crosshair. Easily switch between different crosshair styles with a simple key press.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/251ddbf3dea82498cdbbd5de2a18df7bfa0707de.png


Controller Keybind Support
Yep that's right! Crosshair X now supports Controller Input mapping. Now you can set controller mappings for crosshairs and even switch up the aim and fire keybinds if you’re one of those players who prefer not to use the triggers.  

Make sure to enable "Controller Support"  in the options!

 Aim Keybind Actions
We’ve integrated the settings from the "Toggle" page into a convenient dropdown menu. Now, you can assign a specific action to be triggered when the aim key is pressed, or choose to have no action at all.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/ec602cb99a834d5b4a28b836eac0ec2d11d616e4.png

Supported "Aim" keybind actions:

 No action: No additional action will be triggered when the aim key is pressed.
 Toggle Crosshair (Press): Pressing the aim key will toggle the visibility of the crosshair on and off.
 Toggle Saved Crosshair (Press): Pressing the aim key will toggle the visibility of a previously saved crosshair on and off.
 Hide Crosshair (Hold): Holding the aim key will hide the crosshair.
 Show Crosshair (Hold): Holding the aim key will display the crosshair.
 Show Saved Crosshair (Hold): Holding the aim key will display a previously saved crosshair.


New Saved Crosshair Experience
Save a crosshair with a single click! After saving, a message will appear, allowing you to explore other awesome crosshairs from our community. From this message you can:

 View Saved Crosshairs
 Open the crosshair in the Designer
 Create a keybind for the crosshair

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/5d6ed3ccf2977cff2dd17f42bfb50b008428d9ec.png

New Options Page
We've refreshed the Options page to match the look and feel of our new Keybinds page, featuring a sleek tabular view. This update not only makes the app look more premium but also ensures a consistent user experience across all settings

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/63002102699e1a03e866c3582bdb289643b6a1cc.png


Bug Fixes and More!

 Fixed an issue regarding page content not shifting when window is resized and navbar is collapsed
 New modal will appear when a setting is changed that requires app restart
 Other minor fixes.

notes.title: Update Notes for Crosshair X April 15th, 2024
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We didn't make an announcement for our previous announcements so we'll bundle it all in here.

We've been cleaning up bugs within Crosshair X. The main bug was related to a standard Windows communication protocol that assisted in connecting to the Game bar.

The way to fix this issue wasn't straightforward and it required us to push code, see if Game Bar still worked on all machines, keep trying fixes, and repeating this process till we truly solved the issue. We apologize for that large amount of updates in a short period of time. Hopefully that was the last time we have to push a lot of updates in a short period of time. Crosshair X should also launch faster now.

What else we fixed / added:
- Windows notifications explaining how to re-open Crosshair X if it is minimized
- Added a diagnostic information section in the Support page.
- Application notification indicating to the user when not connected to Game bar
- Updated featured crosshairs
- Fixed minor UI imperfection in Featured page

We have more exciting updates coming!

notes.title: HUGE User Experience Update, Bug Fixes, and more!
notes.content:
Hey Crosshair X Chads, we’ve missed you!
2024 Vision
We're thrilled to announce another update aimed at enhancing the Crosshair X experience. Taking our time to ensure a high level of finish, we've maintained the minimalist aesthetic and premium feel you love. We're eager to showcase the latest improvements and changes that come with this update.

New Look
Right off the bat, you'll notice Crosshair X looks slightly different. We've reorganized things to be more intuitive for you, and we've added a few more quality-of-life features.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/c13ffa76b9ca4b7d10b13dc8b39cbcce2ed1aa33.png
Main Page
Here’s a few noteworthy updates across the main page you’re going to love:

 Overhauled and simplified the legacy Explore, Community, Saved & Share pages all into one section named Crosshairs.
 Overhauled and simplified the legacy Exclusive Fullscreen page into the newly named Display Modes page.
 Added a new and combined page named Position & Size.
 Overhauled the legacy Custom Cursor page and renamed it Cursor.
 Added a dynamic eye icon for the Toggle page denoting whether your crosshair is visible or not.
 Overhauled and simplified the legacy Options and Support pages, with Support being renamed into Help.
 Added Social icons with links in the bottom of the side panel (Discord, TikTok, Youtube & Twitter).

Crosshairs Page

 Added sub-categories in Featured (Rust, Fortnite).
 Changed the Saved icon of a heart into a bookmark.
 Added “Submit Crosshair” form.
 Added the legacy Random page under the Community tab.

Display Modes

 Changed the legacy Windowed Fullscreen mode to the newly named Simple Overlay Mode.
 Changed the legacy Exclusive Fullscreen mode to the newly named Game Bar Mode.
 Moved the monitor selection to the Simple Overlay Mode.
 Overhauled Game Bar health check.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/31fe2a072d1f0c976d002594419d4cee672a274a.png
Position & Size
Many of you have faced issues with the crosshair suddenly becoming too big, too small, or disappearing altogether. Ever found yourself scratching your head, wondering, “What the hell is going on?” We've got you covered! Introducing the new "Position & Size" page. Here, you can not only change your crosshair position but also adjust its scaling. We've also disabled the keybinds that caused many of you problems. Of course, you can re-enable the keybinds if you wish to do so.

 Added settings for the Position keybinds (OFF, ON, WASD 60%).
 Added a new tab named Size.
 Added a slider going from 0.01 (1%) to 10 (1000%).
 Added a Reset button to default the crosshair size back to a value of 1 (100%).
 Added settings for the Size keybind (OFF & ON).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/6e1ab7aa9337e107de403c485ea141db9e6f730f.png
Cursor

 Overhauled Cursor page.
 Added Image size values denoted in pixels.
 Added drop-down menu to allow for further customization of the cursor states.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/dde2da7a5e0b43e29ee8435e57b9cb358b202016.png
Help

 Overhauled FAQ with more representative prompts.
 Added AI Support BOT.
 Added a supplementary Discord tab to help you if you have any unanswered questions by the AI Support bot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/4b6bcbce60d00a4248aa3d167a8cb9455745d08d.png
Get ready for an improved and seamless Crosshair X experience!

notes.title: Complete Product Revamp

We've completely redesigned Crosshair X (formerly known as ProSight) with a beautiful new interface. No more looking like the software was designed in 2005.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/808124b1412c579a1c22502bec4f42a9002bde3f.png

This is really just the beginning of something great. We plan on expanding all of our key offerings such as the Community, the Designer, Hotkeys, etc in the near future so stay tuned!
